guidanceReview.rationale: Resumes Hub recovery after control loss during a runtime update, cancels background recovery when its last client exits, and publishes supervisor status atomically. Interrupted switches are not replayed. Tool guidance, control and extension protocols, and durable state remain compatible with 1.0.2 and earlier epoch-1 releases. The p-wait-for update affects extension polling only; shipped MCP runtime source and guidance are unchanged.
